'''Leaping Toward the Dream!''' (Japanese: '''レッツゴー！プロジェクト・ミュウ！！''' ''Let's Go! Project Mew!!'') is the twenty-first chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN071|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] meet [[Danika]] and [[Quillon]], members of [[Project Mew]], and [[Professor Amaranth]], its leader.
* Goh {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Ninetales}}, qualifying him to start receiving [[Field Research|Trial Missions]].

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* {{Gary}}'s appearance is omitted.
* As the events of ''[[JN009|Finding a Legend!]]'' and ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]'' were skipped, [[Goh's Misdreavus]] and {{TP|Goh|Aerodactyl}} debut here.
